description: Newest value of one World Bank indicator for every member of a country group, highest first. period "common" puts every row on one period (members without it in missing). top (1-50) ranks the members and returns the first N, each row with its rank (order desc or asc). Example: {"indicator":"SP.POP.TOTL","group":"G20","period":"common"}.
name: get_table
title: Get a country group table
